result.title: The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle
result.summary: A predictor is multicalibrated with respect to a class of subpopulations (formally, of functions on the inputs, called auditors) if, for every subpopulation in the class and every value the predictor outputs, the average outcome among the members of that subpopulation who receive that value is close to the value itself. For finite classes, about $\varepsilon^{-3}$ samples are necessary and sufficient to learn a predictor with multicalibration error $\varepsilon$, but the algorithms that attain this rate enumerate the class, which is impossible for the large classes of interest. We ask how many samples suffice when the learner accesses the class only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples and polynomially many ERM calls, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the class. Its dependence on $\varepsilon$ is optimal for all learners. When $d$ is at least about $1/\varepsilon$, every learner that can only access the class through polynomially many ERM calls needs $\tildeΩ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples. Learners with unlimited computation need only $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-3}+d\varepsilon^{-2})$ samples, so the extra factor $1/\varepsilon$ on the dimension term is the price of oracle efficiency. For swap multicalibration, which allows a different function from the class for each predicted value, $\tildeΘ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient. For estimating the error of a given predictor, the ordinary notion is the harder one: the swap error can be estimated with an ERM oracle, whereas the ordinary error is NP-hard to approximate even for classes with linear-time ERM. Consequently, there are classes for which it is computationally easier to learn a multicalibrated predictor than to compute the multicalibration error of a given predictor.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在只能通过 ERM oracle 访问 auditor 函数类时学习多校准（multicalibration）预测器所需样本量，给出约 O(d/ε³) 的算法与匹配下界，并说明 oracle 效率在维度项上多付 1/ε 的代价，还比较了 swap 多校准与误差估计的计算难度。
AI.relevance_reason: 以函数类作为 auditor 审计各子群可靠性的框架，以及统计样本量与计算（oracle 调用）代价之间的权衡，可能为 LVR 中按 latent 假设分组核验证据、评估动态计算收益与成本提供概念类比，但属于较远领域，可供核查。
